text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. The Umamusume entertain the fans 
with various events, food stalls, and 
other attractions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan was one of them. While I was 
thinking about bringing some refreshments—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. You are Jordan's Trainer, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us which event you'll be 
competing in, Jordan-san?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—There is something I wish to ask you 
directly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. Don't touch anything for another five 
minutes, okay? I'm pretty sure your nails 
are dry, but just in case.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whoa... My nails are so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Gets you hyped, right? But since it's made 
for sports, I totally recommend it. I 
already told my mom the brand name.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Mama! They made me look super cute!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-chan, thank you for your help again 
this year~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey~. I like doing nails, and my shift is 
super chill. Plus, it's nice and cool in 
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but it really is wonderful. To 
protect the dreams of children aiming to 
race with vibrant nail art...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aww, praise me moooore, pleeease☆ I'll do 
my best~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan was participating in the 
"Kids' Race & Health Consultation" run by 
volunteers led by the health committee.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Trainer and... Ikuno-chan? What's up? 
That's an unusual pair.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes. Actually, I'm looking for 
Golshi-san, who took Turbo-san with her.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When I consulted McQueen-san, she 
suggested that you might be with 
Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Can you stop treating me and her like a 
package deal? And sorry, but nope. Haven't 
seen Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. Thank you for your cooperation. 
...Still, I must say I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The nail polish isn't a well-known brand, 
but its quality is good, and the farrier 
who looks after me recommended it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I know a lot about nail art. I've 
been buying tons of stuff forever, ya 
know?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"And you too are so very kind, passing 
down your knowledge to the next generation 
without hesitation."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall return to searching for 
Golshi-san. ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And since it was a good stopping point 
anyway, I ended up joining Tosen Jordan 
for her lunch break.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Concentrating so hard made me super 
hungry~. Trainer, buy me a treat~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you totally get it. Alright then, 
thanks in advance.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Man, there are so many customers... Why 
do so many of 'em come here?"
choice_data_list:
Or maybe because you get to see a 
different side of them than usual.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... other than races? Then I'd want more 
followers on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is she talking to a fan? Whoa, that's 
rare. Wonder what kind of fan service she 
gives.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I can't really see from over here. 
Now I'm curious!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Maybe I'll go a bit closer.
Tohhhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Geh?! That voice is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Golshi!! That's the evil 
mastermind Jordan over there, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Golshi! Now, Turbo-san! Hit 
Jordan-san with that special move!

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Golshi
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, what are you trying to do~?! I 
mean, why are you messing with me?! Today 
isn't a race, it's the Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ! Found you, Turbo-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Jordan-san too?! I see, that 
makes it two against two on our side as 
well!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! Why am I getting dragged into 
this~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, her cries were in vain, and Tosen 
Jordan ended up having to wrestle with 
Gold Ship...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, scuse me. Comin' through~

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I'm counting on your support from here 
on out too. And with *that*, as well.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes! One for my friend too, please!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is she actually doing fan service? 
*That* Nakayama...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Oh, it's just Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's the Fan Appreciation Festival, 
so of course I'll give 'em some fan 
service.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~...? But like, I can't even imagine 
it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Well, you can't even enter the 
Takarazuka Kinen without being popular, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? The Takarazuka Kinen...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to waste. Come on, while 
you're here, Mr. Popular, lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Popular...?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
!! Wait, is that the real Jordan?! 
I-I've... I've been following you since 
the Satsuki Sho! You're super cool!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? You're one of my followers!? Whoa, 
thank you~☆

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh. In that case, root for me too, 
alright? Seeing as Jordan and I are fellow 
Satsuki companions and all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I won't let you regret this, got it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!? Would you mind keeping your hands 
off my fans~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tosen Jordan and the others 
interacted with their fans.
